moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The latest Official Chart First Look shows a tight race for number one, with HUGEL, Imael Angel & Ultra Naté's 'Movin' To The Sun' challenging Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas'.

angles.name: Chart Topper Battle
angles.copy: New chart update! Is 'Movin' To The Sun' about to knock Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' off the top spot? What's your pick for UK No.1?

angles.name: Dolly Parton Resurgence
angles.copy: Dolly Parton has three songs in the UK Top 10 this week, including '9 to 5' at its highest ever UK chart position! An absolute legend.

moments.title: Manchester Derby
moments.blurb: Manchester United will host rivals Manchester City at Old Trafford on Sunday, September 13th in a highly anticipated Premier League clash.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: The Manchester Derby is just days away! Who's taking the bragging rights this Sunday? United or City?

angles.name: Local Rivalry
angles.copy: Manchester is set to be divided this Sunday as the Reds host the Blues at Old Trafford. Expect fireworks!

moments.title: Scotland Women vs Canada Rugby
moments.blurb: Scotland Women's rugby team kicks off their WXV Global Series at Hive Stadium, Edinburgh, facing Canada on Saturday, September 12th.

angles.name: Game Day Excitement
angles.copy: Huge weekend for Scotland Women's rugby! They face Canada in the WXV Global Series opener this Saturday. Get behind the team!

angles.name: Home Advantage
angles.copy: Hive Stadium is ready to roar for Scotland Women as they take on Canada in the WXV Global Series on Saturday. Who's going?

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor's 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Legendary 'I Will Survive' singer Gloria Gaynor turns 83 today, September 7th.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Gloria Gaynor! Still surviving and thriving!

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: 'I Will Survive' is more than a song, it's an anthem! Celebrating Gloria Gaynor's birthday today.

moments.title: Chrissie Hynde's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today, September 7th.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Rock on!

angles.name: Pretenders Tribute
angles.copy: Still making waves! Celebrating Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders on her 75th birthday today.

moments.title: Gracie Abrams' 27th Birthday
moments.blurb: Rising pop star Gracie Abrams turns 27 today, September 7th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Big Happy 27th Birthday to the incredible Gracie Abrams! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Mucky Weekender Festival
moments.blurb: The Mucky Weekender Festival, curated by Barry Ashworth of Dub Pistols, takes place from September 10th-12th in Winchester, featuring an eclectic mix of live bands and DJs.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Get ready for a Mucky Weekender! Winchester is hosting three days of live music and DJs from Thursday. Who's heading down?

angles.name: South Coast Festival
angles.copy: Barry Ashworth's Mucky Weekender kicks off near Winchester this Thursday! Local festival-goers, are you ready?

moments.title: Radio 2 In The Park
moments.blurb: Radio 2 In The Park is happening in Stirling from September 11th-13th, bringing a major music event to Scotland.

angles.name: Scottish Festival
angles.copy: Stirling is gearing up for Radio 2 In The Park this weekend! Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Three days of amazing music at Radio 2 In The Park in Stirling starts Friday! Tune in for updates!

moments.title: Totally Thames Festival
moments.blurb: The annual Totally Thames Festival continues throughout September, celebrating London's iconic river with art, culture, music, and events.

angles.name: Riverside Culture
angles.copy: Explore the Totally Thames Festival! A month of art, music, and culture celebrating London's river.

angles.name: London Events
angles.copy: From art installations to boat races, there's still plenty to see and do at the Totally Thames Festival. What's caught your eye?

moments.title: Rosh Hashanah Begins
moments.blurb: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset on Friday, September 11th, marking the start of the Jewish High Holy Days.

angles.name: New Year Greetings
angles.copy: Wishing all celebrating a sweet and happy New Year as Rosh Hashanah begins at sundown on Friday. Shana Tova!

moments.title: London Design Festival
moments.blurb: The London Design Festival runs from September 12th-20th, showcasing contemporary design, architecture, and art across the city.

angles.name: Design Showcase
angles.copy: London transforms into a hub of creativity as the Design Festival kicks off this Saturday! Discover stunning installations and innovative ideas.

moments.title: Practical Magic 2 Cinema Release
moments.blurb: The sequel to the beloved film, 'Practical Magic 2', starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, is set for release in UK cinemas on Friday, September 11th.

angles.name: New Movie Magic
angles.copy: Get ready for more magic! Practical Magic 2, with Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, hits cinemas this Friday. Who's excited?

angles.name: Sequel Anticipation
angles.copy: The Owens sisters are back! Practical Magic 2 is out Friday. Perfect for a cosy cinema trip!

moments.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
moments.blurb: Aardman's new animated film, 'Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom', is released in UK cinemas on September 18th.

angles.name: Family Film Fun
angles.copy: Shaun the Sheep is back on the big screen next week! 'The Beast of Mossy Bottom' looks like perfect family fun.

moments.title: Jesus Christ Superstar in London
moments.blurb: Regent's Park Open Air Theatre's award-winning production of 'Jesus Christ Superstar' is making a welcome return to the London Palladium in September.

angles.name: West End Hit
angles.copy: Jesus Christ Superstar is back in London! Don't miss this acclaimed production at the Palladium.

moments.title: Scott Hoying's 34th Birthday
